sisi.depan: A bank of three seamless, dark metallic elevator doors is set into a black glass wall traced with pulsing violet circuit lines.
sisi.kanan: A stark, cantilevered staircase made of black structural metal ascends along the right wall toward an upper level.
sisi.belakang: A wide, unadorned entrance portal composed of a single sheet of seamless black glass stands closed behind the viewing position.
sisi.kiri: A floor-to-ceiling transparent wall panel offers a view into a deep room filled with rows of server racks that glow with a steady violet light.

tengah: A long, monolithic reception desk, appearing as if carved from a single block of polished black crystal, sits in the middle of the floor facing the entrance.
atas: The high ceiling is a smooth, reflective black surface where thin violet light patterns converge, and a glass-walled executive office on a mezzanine is visible high on the right.
